title: [review] process_route_state_diagnostic is an ungated gate-free install path for sub-/128 prefix routes
description: P2, wave-6 review. rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:862-897 is #[doc(hidden)] pub and NOT feature-gated (unlike process_dao/process_dao_at at :1055/:1091 which are #[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-helpers"))]). It calls extract_updates WITHOUT authorize_dao_prefixes then installs via process_dao_inner. Pre-wave-6 extraction required prefix_len==128 so only host routes could install; now a well-formed /64 body extracts and installs with no delegation check and arbitrary sequence_authority. In-process callers only, no wire path (production ingest is gated); in-tree callers are tests. Fix: feature-gate it like its siblings, or document deliberate trust-the-caller semantics.
